Created **output.svg** (1200×800, valid XML, 33KB) — a single self-contained animated SVG with no external assets.

**Scene includes:**
- Gradient sky with rotating sun, 3 parallax drifting clouds, birds, hills/trees
- Grandstand with red roof, 4 tiers of waving crowd dots, 4 waving roof flags, and “CROUTON PARK” signage
- Tote board/big screen with live blinking dot and 4 odds entries cycling opacity (changing tote), plus finish-beam camera with blinking light
- Infield grass with 1f/2f markers, turf track with mowing stripes, inner/outer white & coloured rails with posts, checkered finish line with 🏁 FINISH banner, photo-finish flash popping periodically, and falling confetti
- Foreground grass beyond the rail with fence and 7 cheering spectators with waving arms

**Four distinct horses** (chestnut/red #3, black/blue-yellow #1, grey/green #5, bay/purple-pink #7):
- Different coat colours, jockey silks/caps, saddle-cloths with numbers, white blazes, manes/tails
- Flowing manes (`maneW` skew) and tails (`tailW` rotate)
- Bobbing bodies (CSS `bob` animations at different phases)

**Motion (mandatory):**
- Each horse uses `animateTransform translate` from `-360` to `1520` across its lane at different speeds/durations (8.2s, 9.6s, 10.8s, 12s) with staggered `begin` offsets, progressing toward the finish line and looping
- 4 legs per horse cycle gallop poses via `animateTransform rotate` (-42° to +44°) at different rates/phases
- Dust puffs behind hooves (`dustP` scale/translate/fade)

**Additional continuous animations (≥4):** bobbing bodies, waving crowd/flags, drifting clouds, dust, changing tote odds, photo-finish flash, sun rays, cheering arms, confetti.
